capabilities: Adds a Lichen wiki as a vault folder
Imports wiki notes as Markdown files named after titles
Sends local edits back to lichen.wiki
Flags same-line conflicts in a conflicts folder
Signs in with Bluesky or atproto handle to save edits
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync service; it only syncs folders mapped to Lichen wikis.
extras: README states the plugin collects no telemetry and lists every network endpoint it contacts.
problem: Obsidian has no way to edit Lichen wiki notes, so wiki changes and vault edits stay separate.

relations.evidence: To send your edits, sign in with your Bluesky or atproto handle.

summary: Two-way syncs Lichen wiki notes into a vault folder as Markdown files and sends local edits back to lichen.wiki.
